title: Alarm zone permanently open
summary: A zone shows open or in alarm and will not seal.
symptoms: Zone shows open with the area secure
Cannot arm because a zone is unsealed
Zone stays in alarm after reset

outline.title: Check the detector or contact itself
outline.detail: Confirm the door is closed and aligned, or that the detector has finished warming up.

outline.title: Isolate the field wiring
outline.detail: Measure the zone loop at the panel with the field wiring disconnected.

outline.title: Compare with the panel's expected EOL values
outline.detail: Use the panel documentation for the configured EOL type.

outline.title: Look for damaged cable or poor terminations
outline.detail: Check joins, junction boxes and terminals along the run.

verification.notes: Demonstration workflow outline. General fault-finding order only — follow the manufacturer's documentation and site procedures.
